acceptance_predicates.description: Repair requires an exact expected revision, exact retained worktree key, open/unowned task, and empty branch.
A successful repair clears only the stale worktree key and preserves all other task metadata and body.
Wrong key, stale revision, active owner/lease, non-empty branch, malformed identity, conflict, or replay is rejected without mutation.
The released coordinator can clear ASB AR-1826's retained legacy key so bind-worktree can bind the reviewed branch and worktree.

definition_of_done: Reviewed signed-DCO upstream release with focused/full gates and durable exact-head evidence is available for ASB AR-1826.

inputs.description: ASB AR-1826 durable blocker and exact stale metadata observation.

outputs.description: Narrow coordinator repair transition and documented contract.

gates.description: Focused positive/negative tests prove exact-match, minimal-clear, fail-closed, and replay behavior.
